ValidationRule.description: Checks whether product location is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), PMC_SS_RouteToQuality__c = True , OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), OR( ISBLANK( PMC_SS_ProductLocation__City__s ), ISBLANK( TEXT(PMC_SS_ProductLocation__CountryCode__s )), ISBLANK( TEXT( PMC_SS_ProductLocation__StateCode__s ))))
